The middle area of the cover letter, you can find the Cardano logo. Also there is the Cardano introduction by the director of this EVENT Prof. Yabe at Tokushima University.
The NFT issued this time is on a blockchain called Cardano. Cardano, like Bitcoin and Ethereum, is a brand name for a blockchain with strong security, and one of its biggest features is a funding voting program called Catalyst that takes place on the blockchain. . The program funds free-thinking projects that, as voted on by users, help advance Cardano. This project and the Aizome NFT project were also made possible through funding from one of these initiatives.These projects have created a connection between blockchain and Tokushima's traditional industries such as plum wine and indigo dyeing. When we talk about blockchain, most people tend to focus on investing in crypto assets, but we hope that you will also see it as a tool for creating new connections.　Please enjoy the charm of Ohata Sake Brewery's plum wine, which continues to produce many high-quality plum wines such as Jisaburo, which aims to have a whiskey-like taste.
Takuya Yabe, Professor, Faculty of Integrated Sciences, Tokushima University
